trigger.observation: Two independently executed raw-FP16 MuonPairVQ controls initialized identically and fed bit-identical gradients retain bit-identical FP16 momentum and identical discrete Pair-VQ codes, but their final materialized weights are not bit-identical.
trigger.cause: MuonPairVQLinear._centroid_projection_ uses CUDA index_add_; atomic accumulation order changes last-bit FP32 centroids between otherwise identical sequential executions.
trigger.codec_causality: The same control showed the reserved-escape decoded momentum was bit-identical to raw FP16. The discrepancy appears only after the pre-existing centroid projection and therefore is not codec distortion.

must_be_bit_exact: decoded FP16 momentum words at every step
Muon polar-update words when evaluated once per identical request
packed state after save/load and the next transition
amended_identity_gate.centroid_projection_nuisance_control: For final codebooks, materialized weights, and loss, run a matched raw/raw control with identical initial state and gradients. Raw-vs-codec deviation may not exceed the simultaneous raw-vs-raw deviation envelope; codes must remain identical.
amended_identity_gate.forbidden_shortcut: Do not retain raw FP16 momentum, change the centroid algorithm, relax packed-state exactness, or add a loss endpoint merely to mask the baseline nondeterminism.
